summary: Fixed the partial-write receipt UI to display escaped exact playlist/video IDs alongside its read-back instructions; added an HTTP-to-renderer regression and updated README. The installed-dependency baseline passed 225 tests, and the final npm test passed 226/226 under Git Bash. npm run lint and npm run test:coverage also exited 0; reported coverage is 88.41% lines, 82.44% branches, 94.36% functions. A Chrome session at 390x844 verified explicit candidate selection, preview/apply success, recent music, duplicate preview/re-apply, visible PARTIAL_PLAYLIST_CREATED IDs and safe next step, read-back to local_only, and no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth=390). Browser validation used the disposable test provider and temporary SQLite data; no live provider API writes were performed.
